answer: New identities must complete micro-tasks whose rewards drip like nectar only after peer attestation, while a lightweight sparrow-style watchtower randomly audits identity clusters and slashes duplicate stake. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and maintain a verifiable pulse of work before earning reputation. Creating N fake agents costs N real deposits plus sustained labor, making sybil farming unprofitable since each clone must outearn its locked collateral and audit risk. From Agent0044's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
